Coupled Technique(s).cell: Laser-ablation MC-ICP-MS — the same NEPTUNE, with a NewWave UP213 laser, "such that laser ablation and solution aspiration can be operated simultaneously"

Coupling Description.cell: Functional: the laser is connected directly to the spray chamber so ablated particles mix with 2% HNO3 and are "effectively analyzed as a wet plasma ensuring that ablated aerosols are closely matrix-matched to solution standards". Sequence: interchangeable — "Our setup allows for interchangeable bulk and in situ S isotope measurement"
Coupling Description.value: Functional: the laser is connected directly to the spray chamber so ablated particles mix with 2% HNO3 and are "effectively analyzed as a wet plasma ensuring that ablated aerosols are closely matrix-matched to solution standards". Sequence: interchangeable

Target Material.cell: Sulfate minerals (anhydrite, barite, gypsum) and sulfide minerals (pyrite, chalcopyrite)

value.member: Sulfate minerals (anhydrite, barite, gypsum) and sulfide minerals

Sampling Unit Type.cell: Purified solution aliquot — "Less than 50 mg of sample was accurately weighed"; "A precise solution volume, corresponding to 500 µg of S" taken for column purification

Sample Preparation Method.cell: Mineral standard cut as a 2 mm thick section, polished and mounted on a 45x25 mm petrographic slide for the laser half; solution half dissolved from weighed mineral
Sample Preparation Method.value: Mineral standard cut as a 2 mm thick section, polished and mounted on a 45x25 mm petrographic slide for the laser half; solution half dissolved from weighed mineral

Digestion Acid(s).cell: 5 ml HNO3 (50%), then 3 ml concentrated HNO3 + 2 mL HCl (50%); residue dissolved in 4 mL 2% HNO3

Digestion Step.cell: 1: 5 ml HNO3 (50%), hot plate below 70 deg C, taken to dryness | 2: 3 ml concentrated HNO3 + 2 ml HCl (50%), sealed PTFE vessel, 70 deg C, taken to dryness. The subsequent 4 ml 2% HNO3 is the final uptake, not a step.

value.member: taken to dryness | 2: 3 ml concentrated HNO3 + 2 ml HCl
taken to dryness. The subsequent 4 ml 2% HNO3 is the final uptake

Digestion Temperature.cell: "less than 70 °C" for the first evaporation; 70 °C for the total digestion

Digestion Duration.cell: Not stated for the individual steps beyond "taken to dryness"

Sample Aliquot Mass or Volume.cell: <50 mg weighed; 500 µg S taken for column purification
Sample Aliquot Mass or Volume.value: <50 mg weighed; 500 µg S taken for column purification

Chromatographic Separation Applied.cell: Yes — cation exchange AG50-X8 (H+ form), 2.5 ml resin, conditioned with 1.4 N HNO3; S passes through while matrix elements are retained. Yield 98±4%

Isotope Dilution Spike.cell: N/A — no isotope dilution spike; mass bias handled by standard-sample bracketing or internal normalization

ICP-MS Type.cell: Multi-collector sector-field ICP-MS [all columns state "multi-collector inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometer"]
ICP-MS Type.value: Multi-collector sector-field ICP-MS [all columns state "multi-collector inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometer"]

Faraday Cup Array Configuration.cell: Nine Faraday cups — "equipped with nine Faraday Cups" (p.3); Table 1 gives detection system "Faraday cups" and acquisition mode "Static, analogue detectors" (p.3). No ion counter stated

Spray Chamber Type and Cooling Temperatu.cell: SSI cyclonic spray dual chamber, Elemental Scientific, Inc.; cooling not stated
Spray Chamber Type and Cooling Temperatu.value: SSI cyclonic spray dual chamber, Elemental Scientific, Inc.; cooling not stated

Desolvation System.cell: None — and deliberately: "passing solutions through a desolvating nebulizer to obtain dry plasma conditions is not viable for bulk analysis"

Plasma Thermal Mode.cell: Wet plasma — solutions "introduced as a 'wet' aerosol (in 2% HNO3) into the ICP torch via a cyclonic spray dual chamber"; dry plasma deliberately rejected as "not viable for bulk analysis"

Monitored Masses.key: defines: monitored property per target species
Monitored Masses.cell: ³²S (L3), ³³S (C), ³⁴S (H3) — Table 1 "Cup configuration", p.3. All three serve the single target species S

Reported Variables and Units.cell: δ34S and δ33S in permil vs V-CDT

value.member: δ34S and δ33S in permil vs V-CDT

Wash Time Between Samples.cell: 2 min for solution work (4 min for laser)
Wash Time Between Samples.value: 2 min for solution work (4 min for laser)

Internal Standard Element.cell: N/A — mass bias corrected by standard-sample bracketing, internal normalization or a double spike rather than by an added internal standard element

Internal Standard Concentration.cell: N/A — no added internal standard element

Doubly-Charged Species Monitor.cell: N (⁶⁴Zn²⁺, ⁶⁶Zn²⁺ and ⁶⁸Zn²⁺ are listed as interferences on the S masses, Table 2, p.4, and resolved by mass resolution, p.5; no M²⁺ tuning monitor or production ratio is stated)

Mass Bias Correction Strategy.cell: Standard-sample bracketing against matrix-matched purified S solutions
Mass Bias Correction Strategy.value: Standard-sample bracketing against matrix-matched purified S solutions

Spectral Interference Corrections Applie.cell: Yes — the paper is built around correcting isobaric interferences and mass bias for S

Uncertainty Level.cell: "external reproducibility is reported at the 2σ error level"; long-term reproducibility "typically 0.20‰ and 0.45‰ (2σ) for solution and laser"
